name: Phaea Blue Palace
positioning: Family-founded seaside resort in Plaka near Elounda, Crete, officially named Phaea Blue, looking across the Gulf of Elounda to Spinalonga islet
best_for: Couples who want a sea-view bungalow, some with a private heated pool
Travelers interested in Cretan food traditions, Greek craftsmanship and wellness

facts.text: The hotel is in Plaka, Elounda, on Crete.
Spinalonga islet lies across from the hotel in the Gulf of Elounda.
For centuries Spinalonga was a fortress, then a leper colony in the first half of the 20th century.
The town of Elounda is 3.6 km from the resort.
The bungalows look out over the Aegean Sea and Spinalonga Island, with a contemporary design of subtle hues and Mediterranean-style accents.
The owners' father, Yannis Sbokos, bought the land where the hotel stands in the late 1980s.
Handwoven textiles made by the owners' grandmother are used in the hotel's spaces.
Handcrafted ceramics by Melina Xenaki are found throughout the hotel, including the lobby and guest rooms.
Visiting wellness specialists offer massages, energy healing, acupuncture, holistic therapies and mindfulness workshops.
Yoga and meditation sessions are regular features on the daily activities calendar.
Guests can take a mini road trip to traditional Cretan villages in the hotel's vintage Mercedes or Cadillac.
Blue Door Taverna, in a former fisherman's stone house, serves traditional Cretan cuisine.

highlights.text: The Deluxe Bungalow Seaview Private Heated Pool has its own private pool.
Experiences include sunset cruises around Spinalonga.
The spa is surrounded by gardens that frame the Aegean Sea, used for yoga, meditation and fitness.
Illustrator Philippos Theodorides painted murals in spaces such as the Island Luxury Suites and the Phaea Blue Villa.
At the Phaea Farmers Feast, guests handpick ingredients in the organic garden with a Phaea Farmer and the hotel's executive chef.

considerations.text: The Minoan palace site of Knossos is 69 km from the resort.
Golf is off-site at the Crete Golf Club, where guests get special discounts.
WhataHotel notes that the location requires transportation to explore nearby areas.
